Acme raises prices for teams

By Jane Writer, 12 November 2026

Acme announced on Tuesday that its Team plan will cost $15 per seat, up from $12.

The change applies to new customers first.

Why now

Acme cited rising infrastructure costs.

  • Hosting costs grew 30%.
  • Support headcount doubled.

Analyst view

"Expect competitors to follow," said one analyst.

Plans compared

PlanOldNew
Starter$0$0
Team$12$15
